content: उपयोगः .²1 Employment, use, application, service; ओषधान्नविहाराणामुपयोगः सुखावहः <ls>Mādh. N.</ls> उपयोगं गम् or व्रज् to be used or employed, serve; व्रजन्ति … अनङ्गलेखक्रिययोपयोगम् <ls>Ku. 1. 7</ls>. .²2 Administration of medicines, or their preparation. .²3 Fitness, suitableness, propriety. .²4 Contact, proximity. .²5 Any act contributing to the fulfilment of a desired object. .²6 Good conduct, observing established customs. .²7 Food; गते च दुर्वाससि सोऽम्बरीषो द्विजोपयोगातिपवित्रमाहरत् <ls>Bhāg. 9. 5. 24</ls>.
